metadata.name: niara_exchange
metadata.description: Niara Exchange: curated listing and atomic settlement for tokenized securities (testnet only)

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: Second step of an admin transfer: the admin proposed by
`propose_change(Admin)` signs once the timelock has elapsed.

accounts.name: new_admin
docs: The proposed admin. It only signs: it pays nothing and is not written,
so a multisig vault (e.g. a Squads v4 vault PDA, through a vault
transaction) can accept.

accounts.name: admin
docs: paid the pending change's rent at `propose_change` and gets it back.

instructions.name: accept_deal
docs: Counterparty delivers its side; both legs, fee and cashback in one go.

accounts.name: proposer
docs: rent when it closes.

accounts.name: proposer_proceeds_account
docs: The proposer's account of the mint it receives: the payment when it
sold, the asset when it bought (mint and token program checked by the
handler).

accounts.name: fee_ledger
docs: Ledger and vault of the fee mint (USDT). The handler requires one leg
of the deal to be that mint; the vault was created with it.

accounts.name: cashback_ledger
docs: Required when the asset listing is cashback-eligible; `None` for
`Currency` assets, which never accrue cashback. Cashback is in the fee
mint, which is then the payment mint.

instructions.name: approve_issuance
docs: Listing authority executes a batch: the program mints via its PDA.

accounts.name: destination
docs: Any account of the asset mint owned by the batch's recipient.

instructions.name: approve_listing
docs: Reinstates a `Suspended` listing; refuses `Pending` and `Quoted`.

instructions.name: burn_with_reason
docs: Holder burns its own tokens, with a reason and a document reference.

instructions.name: cancel_deal
docs: Proposer takes its deposit back while the deal is open. Never paused.

accounts.name: proposer
docs: Receives the vault's rent.

instructions.name: expire_deal
docs: Anyone refunds the proposer once the deal has expired. Never paused.

accounts.name: proposer
docs: rent; does not sign.

instructions.name: freeze_cashback
docs: Stops `withdraw_cashback` for one listing (accrual continues). No
timelock; allowed while paused and in any listing status.

instructions.name: init_fee_vault
docs: Creates the fee vault and fee ledger of `Config.fee_mint` (USDT).

accounts.name: fee_vault
docs: allowlist check (an Anchor `init` would run first and fail on some
rejected mints with an unrelated error). A PDA rather than an ATA:
anyone can create an ATA, so creating one could be front-run to block
this instruction.

instructions.name: open_deal
docs: Proposer escrows its side of a bilateral deal with a named counterparty.

accounts.name: proposer
docs: Pays the rent of the deal (never closed) and of its vault (refunded to
the proposer when the vault closes).

accounts.name: deal_vault
docs: deposited mint (which depends on `proposer_side`) owned by `deal`.

accounts.name: proposer_deposit_account
docs: The proposer's account of the mint it escrows: the asset when selling,
the payment when buying (mint and token program checked by the handler).

instructions.name: pay_listing_fee
docs: Issuer pays the quoted listing fee; the listing becomes `Approved`.

accounts.name: issuer
docs: Signs the transfer out of its own account of the fee mint.

accounts.name: listing
docs: `Currency` listings have `issuer == Pubkey::default()`, which cannot sign.

accounts.name: fee_mint
docs: The fee mint in force. The handler also requires it to be the mint
the quote was made in, after the status check (an unquoted listing
has no quote mint, and must fail with `ListingNotQuoted`).

accounts.name: fee_vault
docs: The fee vault is a PDA that only `init_fee_vault` creates, so the
seeds and the mint identify it; no vault-authority account is needed
to pay into it.

accounts.name: source
docs: Any account of the fee mint owned by the issuer.

instructions.name: quote_listing
docs: Listing authority quotes the listing fee of a `Pending` or `Quoted`
issuer listing (spec §3.13). `valuation` is in fee-mint base units.

instructions.name: request_issuance
docs: Issuer proposes a numbered batch; mints nothing.

accounts.name: issuer
docs: Pays the rent of the batch record.

accounts.name: listing
docs: `Currency` listings have `issuer == Pubkey::default()`, which cannot sign.

accounts.name: batch
docs: Batch numbers are sequential per listing, starting at 1.

instructions.name: settle
docs: `match_id` is the off-chain match (fill) id; each settles at most once.

accounts.name: settlement_operator
docs: Pays the rent of the `SettlementRecord`.

accounts.name: payment_mint
docs: Always the fee mint (USDT): the seller receives it and pays the fee out
of it (spec §3.4).

accounts.name: seller
docs: seller token accounts below; it does not sign.

accounts.name: buyer
docs: buyer token accounts below; it does not sign.

accounts.name: settlement_record
docs: Replay guard: `init` fails if this match was already settled.

instructions.name: sweep_excess
docs: Treasury takes the fee vault's balance above what the ledger owes.

accounts.name: listing
docs: `Currency` listings have `issuer == Pubkey::default()`, which cannot sign.

accounts.name: destination
docs: Any account of the payment mint, chosen by the issuer.

types.name: AssetClass
docs: Asset class. Fixes the trading mode on-chain:
`Equity` -> order book (delegate); the others -> P2P escrow.

types.name: BurnReason
docs: Why a holder burned tokens (`burn_with_reason`).

types.name: CashbackFreezeSet
docs: Cashback withdrawals for one listing were frozen (`frozen == true`) or
unfrozen by the listing authority. Accrual is never affected.

types.name: CashbackLedger
docs: Issuer cashback owed for one listing, in the fee mint it was created for
(`payment_mint`). PDA: `["cashback", listing, fee_mint]`. Created by
`init_cashback_ledger` for the current `Config.fee_mint`.

types.name: Config
docs: Global protocol configuration. PDA: `["config"]`.

fields.name: fee_mint
docs: The USDT mint. Every fee, and so all cashback, is charged in it; one
fee vault and one fee ledger exist, for this mint (spec §3.4).
Changed only through the timelock.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Protocol fee, in bps of the fee-mint leg. Always `<= MAX_FEE_BPS`.

fields.name: cashback_bps
docs: Issuer cashback, in bps **of the fee**. Always `<= BPS_DENOMINATOR`.

fields.name: paused
docs: Circuit breaker. Trading instructions revert while set.

fields.name: timelock_secs
docs: Delay between `propose_change` and `execute_change`. Fixed at init.

types.name: ConfigChange
docs: A timelocked change to `Config`. Each variant has its own pending slot
(`["pending", kind]`), so at most one proposal per kind is in flight.

types.name: Deal
docs: A bilateral P2P deal (spec §3.5). PDA: `["deal", proposer, deal_id]`.
Never closed: once it leaves `Open` it can be neither accepted nor
refunded again (the status is the replay guard).

fields.name: deal_id
docs: Off-chain negotiation id (UUID).

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: `Config.fee_bps` and `Config.cashback_bps` when the deal was opened.
The fee is part of the agreed terms: `accept_deal` charges these, not
the values in force then.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: The deal can be accepted while `now < expires_at`, and expired once
`now >= expires_at`.

fields.name: resolved_at
docs: When executed, cancelled or expired; 0 while `Open`.

fields.name: vault_bump
docs: Bump of the escrow vault `["deal_vault", deal]`.

types.name: DealCancelled
docs: The proposer cancelled an open deal and got `deposit_amount` (plus any
`vault_excess`) of `deposit_mint` back.

types.name: DealExecuted
docs: A P2P deal executed. Same accounting as `Settled`, on the USDT leg:
`fee` is in `fee_mint` (the payment mint, or the asset mint when the
currency sold is USDT) and was deducted from what the receiver of that leg
got; `cashback` is the part of `fee` credited to the asset issuer (0 for
`Currency` assets). `vault_excess` is what the escrow vault held beyond the
deposit (tokens sent to it outside `open_deal`); it went to the
counterparty with the deposit.

types.name: DealExpired
docs: An expired deal was refunded to the proposer (permissionless crank).

types.name: DealOpened
docs: The proposer escrowed its side of a P2P deal (`asset_amount` if selling,
`payment_amount` if buying). `fee_bps` and `cashback_bps` are the rates
fixed for this deal (the config's at open), charged on execution.

types.name: DealSide
docs: The proposer's side of a P2P deal. It decides what the proposer escrows:
the asset when selling, the payment when buying.

types.name: DealTerms
docs: Terms of a P2P deal as agreed off-chain. The mints come from the accounts
of `open_deal`.

fields.name: counterparty
docs: The only wallet that can accept (v1 has no open offers).

fields.name: asset_amount
docs: Raw units of the asset mint.

fields.name: payment_amount
docs: Raw units of the payment mint; the fee is taken out of it.

types.name: ExcessSwept
docs: Unaccounted tokens (sent to the fee vault outside `settle`) swept by the
treasury. `vault_balance_after` equals the unwithdrawn fees and cashback.

types.name: FeeLedger
docs: Fee accounting for the fee mint (`payment_mint`, USDT). PDA:
`["fees", fee_mint]`. Created by `init_fee_vault` together with the fee
vault `["fee_vault", fee_mint]`. One exists per fee mint ever configured
(normally one); a timelocked fee-mint switch leaves the old one
withdrawable.
`fees_collected` is the gross trading fee (protocol share + cashback);
`listing_fees_collected` is protocol revenue only. Derived:
- protocol share accrued =
`fees_collected - cashback_accrued + listing_fees_collected`
- unwithdrawn =
`fees_collected + listing_fees_collected - protocol_withdrawn - cashback_withdrawn`
Invariant 4: the fee vault balance equals the unwithdrawn amount. Anyone
can transfer tokens into the vault, so between sweeps it is `>=`; such
donations are not accounted, cannot be withdrawn as fees or cashback, and
`sweep_excess` (treasury) moves them out, restoring equality.

fields.name: fees_collected
docs: Trading fees (`settle`, `accept_deal`), cashback share included.

fields.name: cashback_accrued
docs: Sum of `CashbackLedger::accrued` over all listings, in this mint.

fields.name: cashback_withdrawn
docs: Sum of `CashbackLedger::withdrawn` over all listings, in this mint.

fields.name: listing_fees_collected
docs: Listing fees paid in this mint (`pay_listing_fee`, spec §3.13). No
cashback share. Appended last.

types.name: FeeVaultInitialized
docs: The fee vault and fee ledger of `fee_mint` exist; fees in it can be
collected from now on.

fields.name: fee_mint
docs: The USDT mint (spec §3.4). `init_fee_vault` then creates its vault.

types.name: IssuanceBatch
docs: One requested increase of supply (spec §3.12). PDA:
`["batch", listing, batch_no (u64 LE)]`. Never closed: it is the on-chain
issuance record.

fields.name: recipient
docs: Wallet that receives the tokens: the holder of record.

fields.name: doc_hash
docs: Hash of the document authorizing the batch, registered in Niara-Register.

fields.name: resolved_at
docs: When approved or rejected; 0 while `Requested`.

types.name: IssuanceExecuted
docs: A batch was minted. `recipient` is the holder wallet; `destination` the
token account (owned by `recipient`) that received the tokens.

types.name: Listing
docs: Listing of an asset mint. PDA: `["listing", asset_mint]`.

fields.name: issuer
docs: Mint authority at submission time. `Pubkey::default()` for `Currency`
listings, which have no issuer on Niara.

fields.name: doc_hash
docs: Hash of the offering document (registered in Niara-Register).

fields.name: approved_at
docs: Unix timestamp of the latest approval; 0 until approved.

fields.name: next_batch_no
docs: Number of the next issuance batch (batches are numbered from 1).
0 for `Currency` listings, which have no issuance.

fields.name: issued
docs: Sum of executed issuance batches.

fields.name: burned
docs: Sum of burns through `burn_with_reason`. Invariant 11:
`supply == issued - burned` (on-chain `<=`: holders can also burn
directly through the token program).

fields.name: cashback_frozen
docs: Set by the listing authority (no timelock) to stop `withdraw_cashback`
for this listing, e.g. after an issuer key compromise (spec §9.5).
Cashback keeps accruing while frozen.

fields.name: valuation
docs: Issuer valuation in base units of `listing_fee_mint`. Public on-chain.

fields.name: listing_fee_bps
docs: `1..=MAX_LISTING_FEE_BPS` once quoted.

fields.name: listing_fee
docs: `ceil(valuation * listing_fee_bps / 10_000)`.

fields.name: listing_fee_mint
docs: `Config.fee_mint` at `quote_listing`: the unit of `valuation` and
`listing_fee`, and the only mint `pay_listing_fee` accepts.

fields.name: quote_expires_at
docs: The quote can be paid while `now < quote_expires_at`.

fields.name: listing_fee_paid
docs: 0 until `pay_listing_fee`, then `listing_fee` (invariant 13).

types.name: ListingFeePaid
docs: The issuer paid the listing fee into the fee vault (protocol revenue, no
cashback). Followed by `ListingApproved` in the same instruction.

types.name: ListingQuoted
docs: The listing authority quoted the listing fee (spec §3.13). `valuation` and
`listing_fee` are in base units of `fee_mint`; the quote can be paid while
`now < expires_at`. A re-quote emits a new event that replaces this one.

types.name: ListingStatus
docs: Variants are only ever appended: the discriminant is stored on-chain.

types.name: PendingChange
docs: A proposed `ConfigChange` waiting for its timelock. PDA: `["pending", kind]`.

types.name: Settled
docs: One order-book settlement. `match_id` is the off-chain match (fill) id.
`payment_amount == seller_receives + fee`; `cashback` is the part of `fee`
credited to the asset issuer.

types.name: SettlementRecord
docs: Replay guard for one settled match. PDA: `["settled", match_id]`.
Never closed: closing it would allow the same `match_id` to settle again.

constants.name: BATCH_SEED
docs: Per issuance batch: `["batch", listing, batch_no (u64 LE)]`.

constants.name: CASHBACK_SEED
docs: Per (listing, payment mint): `["cashback", listing, payment_mint]`.

constants.name: DEAL_SEED
docs: Per P2P deal: `["deal", proposer, deal_id]`. Never closed: its status is
the replay guard.

constants.name: DEAL_VAULT_SEED
docs: Per P2P deal: `["deal_vault", deal]` escrow token account whose authority is
the deal PDA. Closed when the deal is executed, cancelled or expired.

constants.name: FEE_LEDGER_SEED
docs: Per payment mint: `["fees", payment_mint]` fee ledger.

constants.name: FEE_VAULT_SEED
docs: Per payment mint: `["fee_vault", payment_mint]` token account.

constants.name: MAX_DEAL_DURATION_SECS
docs: Longest a P2P deal may stay open: `expires_at <= now + 30 days`.

constants.name: MAX_FEE_BPS
docs: Hard cap on the protocol fee: 0.5% of the fee-mint (USDT) leg. Business
rule: Niara charges at most 0.5%.

constants.name: MAX_LISTING_FEE_BPS
docs: Hard cap on the listing fee: 1% of the issuer's valuation (spec §3.13).
Business rule; the 0.1% floor is pricing policy and is not enforced.

constants.name: MAX_QUOTE_DURATION_SECS
docs: Longest a listing-fee quote stays payable: `expires_at <= now + 30 days`.

constants.name: MINT_AUTHORITY_SEED
docs: Per asset mint: `["mint_authority", asset_mint]`, the mint authority of
every issuer-listed asset after `submit_listing`. Holds no data.

constants.name: MIN_TIMELOCK_SECS
docs: Bounds for the admin timelock. The lower bound keeps the timelock meaningful;
the upper bound prevents bricking the config with an unreachable delay.

constants.name: SETTLED_SEED
docs: Per settled match: `["settled", match_id]` replay guard.

constants.name: VAULT_SEED
docs: PDA signer for delegated transfers and the fee vaults. Holds no data.
